scope: 约55分钟只读故障观测；额外探测会参与数据库负载，不作为无干扰性能通过证据
queries: SET SESSION max_execution_time=1500; START TRANSACTION WITH CONSISTENT SNAPSHOT, READ ONLY; SELECT 'RUNTIME',COUNT(*),COALESCE(SUM(version),0) FROM room_runtime; SELECT 'PROJECTION',COUNT(*),COALESCE(SUM(event_count),0) FROM room_event_projection; SELECT 'READY',COUNT(*) FROM outbox_event WHERE status='READY' UNION ALL SELECT 'CLAIMED',COUNT(*) FROM outbox_event WHERE status='CLAIMED' UNION ALL SELECT 'DEAD',COUNT(*) FROM outbox_event WHERE status='DEAD' UNION ALL SELECT 'DONE',COUNT(*) FROM outbox_event WHERE status='DONE'; COMMIT;
